request.title: Who runs an MCP server, and where?
request.why: Next week you choose where to deploy; this 3-minute read makes that choice easy.
request.body:
**Nothing to do. Tap "read" when done.**

MCP is a protocol, not a hosted service.

| Role | Who runs it | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Host | The AI app you use | an IDE agent, a chat app |
| Server | Your machine (local) or the tool's maker (remote) | your own API, a vendor's API |

- Local server: a process on your machine; only that machine can use it.
- Remote server: deployed online behind a token; works from your phone too.
